function.name: document_render
function.description: Render a workspace markdown file to PDF or HTML without shell access. Supports staged document inputs at artifacts/in/. Writes exclusively under artifacts/out/ and returns a path, format and byte count; existing files are never overwritten. PDF supports Unicode including Czech. External resources/images are not fetched. Use a different out_path when retrying an existing output.

out_path.description: Optional output path under artifacts/out/ with matching extension; defaults to artifacts/out/<source-basename>.<format>.
